description: Preview the tax an invoice or order would get from the registrations saved on Settings, Tax (US nexus, EU VAT OSS, other VAT and GST), without saving anything: the subtotal, each jurisdiction's rate and amount, the total, and why (calculated, not registered, reverse charge, exempt). US rates are state-level only unless a registration overrides them. Early access: answers that it is not released until tax calculation is switched on for the workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

amount.description: The pre-tax amount, in the currency's major unit.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, like USD or EUR.

customer_id.description: A customer whose saved address and tax id to use when destination is not given.

customer_tax_id.description: The customer's VAT or tax id; an EU business with one is reverse charged.

date.description: The sale date (YYYY-MM-DD); today when absent.

country.description: ISO country code or English name, like DE or Germany.

name: calculate_tax
